newsitem.title: RUSSIA: CITY OF MOSCOW POSTPONES EUROBOND ISSUE BY '97 END.
newsitem.headline: CITY OF MOSCOW POSTPONES EUROBOND ISSUE BY '97 END.

text.p: The City of Moscow will issue its second Eurobond by the end of the year, not this autumn as was previously announced, a city government spokesman said on Monday.
"It's a lengthy process," Mikhail Chernyshov told Reuters. "Maybe it will happen in November, maybe in December."
Previously, a city government source said the issue would be made at the end of September or start of October.

Chernyshov said that currently the city was holding a tender for lead-managers and about 30 investment companies and banks had applied. He said the city was likely to choose two or more lead-managers by the end of August.
Moscow's first Eurobond was led by Nomura International and CS First Boston in May.
